## SURVIVING BRIEFS

### d1 — Synthesis products (retry, task-mwjc6wdg-3) — GOOD

**Sources:** Microsoft Copilot Studio docs (RAG orchestration, Researcher agent), arxiv 2609.29444 (IterSynth)

**Brief:**
- **Copilot Studio:** generative orchestration is an LLM-driven planning layer *embedded in the agent runtime* — interprets intent, decomposes requests, selects tools/knowledge, executes steps. Findings route **inline** through this layer, not through a separate planner module. Researcher agent handles multi-step research producing source-cited reports.
- **IterSynth (academic):** explicitly *decouples* roles — a distinct **Planner** identifies information needs; a distinct **Synthesizer** integrates evidence into an evolving summary state; they alternate iteratively. Contrasts with ReAct-style agents where one policy couples planning, evidence use, and synthesis.
- **Coverage gap (SCOUT's own honesty):** "No primary documentation for Devin, Manus, ChatGPT agent, Agentforce, Sierra, or Decagon was returned; those products cannot be addressed from this source set."

**Value:** the Copilot-vs-IterSynth contrast is a genuine architectural data point — the industry spans both inline-orchestration and dedicated-planner designs. IterSynth is a real arxiv paper supporting role decoupling.

### d5 — Regression pipelines & versioned learnings (task-mwjcf7ty-4) — GOOD

**Sources:** langchain.com/langsmith-platform, langchain.com/blog/introducing-langsmith-engine, braintrust.dev regression-tests article, venturebeat LangSmith Engine coverage

**Brief:**
- **LangSmith Engine:** continuously watches production traces → clusters failures into named/prioritized issues → diagnoses root causes → proposes fixes for review → when fix surfaces, proposes a custom online evaluator AND pulls failing traces into the offline eval dataset "so the same failure cannot silently recur after release." Every resolved issue strengthens the eval suite.
- **Braintrust:** capture failed traces → label failure modes → promote spans into regression datasets → write scorers → run in CI and live traffic. Production traces are source of truth, capturing inputs, outputs, tool calls, retrieved context, **prompt versions, model versions, runtime metadata**. Root-cause method: open full trace → walk span tree to first failing step → isolate layer → convert to regression test.
- **failure-forensics** (GitHub): eval dashboard KPIs — pass rate, failure-type charts, regression-pass-rate-over-time, "Run Regression Suite" button.
- **Conflict noted:** enterprise feedback that no single provider should own observability (neutral multi-model layer) vs LangSmith's integrated positioning.
- **Coverage gaps (honest):** Arize trace-to-dataset, MS Agent Governance Toolkit, prompt registries, policy versioning, policy-as-code, CrewAI scoped views, AutoGen MemoryController, governed shared memory — all unaddressed.

**Value:** LangSmith Engine and Braintrust are exactly the Stage 5 (failure→regression) mechanism my spec proposed — SCOUT independently surfaced the same pattern from primary sources. "Prompt versions, model versions" in trace metadata = the versioned-learnings requirement.

## CONVERGENCE ANALYSIS — SCOUT arm vs Devin arm (`CORTEX_SYNTHESIS_ROLE_SPEC.md`)

### Dual-sourced agreement
| Finding | Devin arm | SCOUT arm |
|---|---|---|
| Dedicated planner/synthesizer role is a real architectural pattern | Devin Fusion lead, LangGraph supervisor, SRE IC/Planning | IterSynth's explicit Planner/Synthesizer decoupling (arxiv 2609.29444) |
| Inline orchestration is the alternative | LangGraph subagents pattern noted | Copilot Studio generative orchestration embedded in runtime |
| Failure→regression pipeline is the standard | LangSmith eval loop, Arize Signal | LangSmith Engine + Braintrust trace→dataset→scorer→CI — same mechanism, primary sources |
| Versioned learnings need version+eval linkage | LangSmith prompt hub commits/tags | "prompt versions, model versions" captured in production traces |

### SCOUT's genuine additions
- **IterSynth** (arxiv 2606.29444v1... reported as 2609.29444) — role-decoupled Planner/Synthesizer alternating with persistent summary state. Direct academic support for the dedicated-role recommendation. My arm didn't find this paper.
- **LangSmith Engine** specifics — automated trace clustering → root-cause → proposed fix → auto-generated online evaluator + offline dataset promotion. More concrete than my arm's LangSmith eval docs.
- **Braintrust trace→regression method** — "walk the span tree to the first failing step" is a more precise procedure than my spec described.
- **Copilot Studio's inline orchestration** — evidence that the industry hasn't converged; dedicated planner is *a* pattern, not *the* pattern. My spec should acknowledge this honestly.

### SCOUT's persistent weaknesses (third confirmation)
- Coverage collapse on named systems: d1 got 2/10 products at primary depth; d5 missed 7/9 named mechanisms
- Marketing/listicle drift when primary docs aren't surfaced by search (d1 third attempt: "no primary docs returned" — honest but useless)
- Structural ceiling: briefs report findings; cannot synthesize spec, map to Cortex code, or rank recommendations
- **New failure mode observed:** task-result retention (200) evicts research results within hours — briefs must be compiled same-day. This is a Cortex data-retention gap, not a model failure.

### Net assessment
The surviving SCOUT arm **strengthened** the spec: IterSynth + LangSmith Engine + Braintrust gave primary-source confirmation of the dedicated-role and regression-pipeline recommendations, and Copilot Studio's inline orchestration added a necessary counterpoint my arm underweighted. The arm's collapse (rate-limit → failover → budget cap → retention eviction) was itself the best possible demonstration of why STRATEGIST + stages 4–8 are needed.
